data.synopsis:
Set near the end of the Showa period in the late 1980s, an old mansion in Misaki Town is rumored to be the home of a witch.

Aoko abruptly enters the world of magi after her grandfather suddenly decides to have Aoko become the Aozaki family's successor. Since then, Aoko moves into the Kuonji Mansion and begins to learn magecraft from the young magus Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. After witnessing the two using magecraft, Soujuurou Shizuki is also forced to live with them until a rune to remove his memories is discovered. 

(Source: Type-Moon Fandom Wiki)

フールナイト
Fool Night

data.title: Fool Night
data.title_japanese: フールナイト
data.synopsis:
The earth of the distant future is covered in thick clouds, and the sun no longer shines. Plants wither, and oxygen is thin. To fight extinction, humankind has developed a technology that turns humans into plants, providing a small amount of oxygen. Is this process sustainable? Is it ethical? Toshiro Kamiya must consider these questions as he's faced with a difficult choice—save his family or save himself.

Kamiya is at the end of his rope. His mother is ill, and his job barely pays for her medication, much less food. With few options left, he considers the life-changing process of floromorphosis. Ready to give his body up for a payday, Kamiya is about to explore the limits of society's waning humanity.

(Source: VIZ Media)

data.title: Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation: Episode of Savanaclaw
data.title_japanese: ディズニー ツイステッドワンダーランド ザ アニメーション エピソード オブ サバナクロー
data.synopsis:
One day, high school student Yuuka "Yuu" Hirasaka finds herself transported to the world of Twisted Wonderland after a black carriage crashes into her. Though she hopes to return home to Tochigi in Japan, the magicless judo practitioner ends up enrolling in the prestigious magic academy Night Raven College.

As Yuu acclimates to her new life, the annual interdorm Spelldrive tournament at the school is set to begin. The team-based game tests the physical and magical strength of each dorm's seven best athletes, all while being broadcast throughout the magical world. For the past two years, the Diasomnia dorm has crushed the competition thanks solely to their powerful housewarden, Malleus Draconia.

Amidst the excitement, a series of incidents across campus befalling the top Spelldrive players from all dorms is rendering them unable to compete. Concerned that these are no mere accidents, the headmage of the academy tasks Yuu and her dormmate Grim to investigate. While the pair dives deeper into the matter, one housewarden in particular is determined to defeat Diasomnia—even if he must use underhanded methods to do so.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

data.title: Dark Machine: The Animation
data.title_japanese: DARK MACHINE -The Animation-
data.synopsis:
In the near future, the e-sport Dark Machine has become a global phenomenon, reshaping society and even Japan's economy. The only region in Japan designated as a special economic zone for Dark Machine is Golden Valley, a city dominated by its reigning top player Ajima, the seventh person to inherit the title of Senki—the strongest player in the game.

Following his late grandfather's last words, "Find Senki," Kairi travels to Golden Valley. There, he unexpectedly meets Rudra, a girl being hunted by Ajima's group, the Aldabil. Drawn into her troubles, Kairi becomes a Dark Machine player himself. Through one intense battle after another, he begins to develop his own hidden talent.

As Kairi rises through the ranks, he moves closer to facing Senki—and to discovering the truth behind his grandfather's final message. His fight to reach the top of Dark Machine is about to begin.

(Source: MAL News)

data.synopsis:
Nuclear winter has arrived, civilization has collapsed, and humanity is no longer the master of the world. Species mutations and scarce resources create an unpredictable future and environment, leading to a series of crises. To protect themselves, humanity has built walls, but outside these walls, survival depends on blood and fire. 

The protagonist, Ren Xiaosu, and his younger brother, Yan Liuyuan, are among them. They were just ordinary teenagers in the wilderness, without shelter or a way out; their only support was each other. But fate granted them the power to awaken in their dire circumstances. The Jingshan earthquake caused the collapse of Wall 113, fully shattering the post-apocalyptic chaos. During their escape, Ren Xiaosu and his family rescue Luo Lan, the military leader, and enter Wall 109. A new life is about to begin, but the real test has only just begun…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
